title: Happy Toddler Girl Playing in Backyard Kiddie Pool, 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A joyous candid black-and-white snapshot captures a smiling toddler girl laughing excitedly while splashing in a shallow pool set up in a suburban backyard. She is dressed in a striped swimsuit, playing with a small container in the water. In the background, an adult relaxes in a lawn chair under bright sunshine, encapsulating post-war American suburban leisure and childhood summer traditions.
